name: Captive
source:
A man has been stalking you for some time now. One late evening, he breaks into your house. But you're no ordinary victim. In a turn of events, he winds up locked in your basement. What are you going to do with him?

In "Captive", you are in charge of the fate of the yandere love interest. Will you be gentle or rough?

[From [url=https://nightmareweaverz.itch.io/captive]itch.io[/url]]
